comparisons.peer_summary: The company performs periodic risk and control efficacy assessments through internal self-assessments, external penetration tests, and red team engagements, using results to allocate resources and improve controls. Third parties, including forensics firms, are used to augment incident response, while a vendor management program integrates information security risk into third-party relationships.
comparisons.comparison: Both Goldman Sachs (GS) and Morgan Stanley (MS) describe using external testing, specifically penetration tests and red team engagements, to assess the efficacy of cybersecurity controls. GS explicitly states these are performed in conjunction with third parties to gauge program performance, while MS notes the utilization of these same methods to assess control efficacy and strengthen the Cybersecurity Program.

sentences.text: To assess the efficacy of our controls and defenses designed to mitigate cybersecurity risk, we utilize internal and external testing, including penetration testing and red team engagements.

We perform periodic assessments of control efficacy through our internal risk and control self-assessment process, as well as a variety of external technical assessments, including external penetration tests and "red team" engagements where third parties test our defenses.

comparisons.peer_topic: Ongoing Cybersecurity Risk Monitoring and Mitigation
comparisons.peer_summary: Technology Risk continuously monitors cybersecurity threats and allocates resources to mitigate those risks. In response to global AI-enabled fraud and ransomware, the company has emphasized phishing and cybersecurity training and allocated additional resources for business continuity, though it cannot eliminate all risks or assure that undetected incidents have not occurred.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies address cybersecurity training as a preventative measure against specific threats. MS maintains a global training program that includes regular phishing simulations for employees and consultants. Similarly, GS emphasizes phishing and cybersecurity training for employees in response to the proliferation of AI-enabled fraud and ransomware attacks.

sentences.text: Additionally, we maintain a global training program covering cybersecurity risks and requirements, including heightened security training to specialized employees, and conduct regular phishing email simulations for our employees and consultants as preventative measures.

For example, in response to the proliferation of AI-enabled fraud and ransomware attacks that continue to be reported globally, we have emphasized phishing and cybersecurity training for our employees and allocated additional resources for business continuity.

comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm provides mandatory global security awareness and training, supplemented by phishing tests and specialized role-based training, alongside a Global Privacy Program requiring periodic data privacy training.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan Chase (JPM) and MS describe mandatory global training programs supplemented by phishing simulations. JPM notes that its security awareness training is mandatory for all employees globally and is supplemented by Firmwide testing initiatives including periodic phishing tests, mirroring MS's description of a global training program including regular phishing email simulations for employees and consultants.
